creation.bonus_skill_overlap: If a bonus skill is already a Focus Skill, +1 to any other skill instead.

advancement.role_advancement: Every Role you hold gains its next Step at each tier change, with nothing to choose. A further Role uses a Feat slot and starts at your current tier.
advancement.focus_skill_swap: At each tier change you may replace one Focus Skill with another.

capstone.text: One free Gated Feat, ignoring its requirements other than tier, and a scene-level capability defined with the GM.

advancement.governing_ability: Any of the nine. Can be changed once per tier with GM approval.
advancement.specialty_rule: Your first Specialty is free at creation, and may instead be a second Stepped Feat. Any further Specialty uses a Feat slot. Its Abilities arrive by tier.

initiative.roll: d20 + the primary Domain's Deflect Ability (+ Reputation when opponents know the character)

methods.name: Roll
methods.text: d20 + primary Domain Deflect Ability. Ties: higher Deflect Ability, then roll again.

methods.name: Pick Your Place
methods.text: Pick from 30, 26, 22, 18, 14, 10, continuing down in fours. No duplicates.

methods.name: Roll and Swap
methods.text: Everyone rolls as normal, then the table swaps numbers freely.

deflect: 10 + the Domain's Deflect Ability (Agility, Acuity, Serenity) + the tier bonus. Armor does not raise it: DR comes off the damage.

boon_menu.name: Momentum
boon_menu.effect: +2 to all your rolls until the end of your next turn

boon_menu.name: Recovery
boon_menu.effect: Unmark 1 box from any one pool

boon_menu.name: Tempo
boon_menu.effect: One additional Action this round, once per round (Seasoned tier and above)

boon_menu.name: Guard
boon_menu.effect: +2 to Deflect and Defend until your next turn

boon_menu.name: Opening
boon_menu.effect: The next ally to attack the same target this round gets +2

boon_menu.name: Break Through
boon_menu.effect: This hit ignores the target’s armor DR, once per round

boon_menu.name: Reset
boon_menu.effect: Regain one spent Reaction, once per round

boon_menu.name: Keen Eye
boon_menu.effect: Ask the GM one question about the scene or a target, and get a true answer

boon_menu.name: Grace
boon_menu.effect: Give any one of the above to an ally in Near range instead of taking it yourself

effects_rule: Declare the type before rolling. Spend boxes before the roll (Stamina for weapons, Mana for Powers, Resolve for Spirit and social actions), paid win or lose. Non-Signature type: -1 to the roll. Your Offensive Signature's 1-box rung is free on a Surge 2+ hit, if you choose.
costs_rule: Basic Attack, Basic Cast and Basic Press are free. Anything added costs at least 1 box. Maneuvers: Mastery Floor by tier. Surge: not reduced except by Surge Discipline.

wealth_tiers.name: Destitute
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Survival mode. Homeless or completely cut off from resources.

wealth_tiers.name: Poor
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Day-to-day survival. No savings. Basic needs barely met.

wealth_tiers.name: Struggling
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Working class. Functional but stretched. No financial cushion.

wealth_tiers.name: Average
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Stable income. Modest gear. Needs covered, small savings possible.

wealth_tiers.name: Comfortable
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Professional class. Good equipment, socially respected.

wealth_tiers.name: Wealthy
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Elite. Resources rarely a constraint. Doors open by default.

wealth_tiers.name: Very Wealthy
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Significant personal fortune. Institutional leverage available.

wealth_tiers.name: Filthy Rich
wealth_tiers.daily_life: Unlimited resources. Access is the only constraint.

quality.name: Improvised
quality.implement: A borrowed symbol, a sigil scratched in dirt

pool_transfer.text: Once per encounter, as a free action, spend boxes from any pool to restore boxes in any other: every 2 spent restores 1, up to 5 restored.

boon_rule: A Boon triggers when the natural die meets your tier's threshold. Choose from the Boon Menu (tier boon_choices), never the same option twice. Tempo needs Seasoned or above.
hit_cap: One hit crosses at most 5 + tier number boxes, after armor. Each Surge box raises that hit's cap by 1. Healing has no cap.

bane_menu.name: Complication
bane_menu.effect: Something goes wrong in the fiction: a weapon jams, a rope frays, an alarm sounds.

bane_menu.name: Opening
bane_menu.effect: One enemy in range makes a free attack against you.

bane_menu.name: Spent
bane_menu.effect: Lose the boxes you spent on this roll's Surge or Effect a second time. Spent doesn't repeat boxes already crossed by backlash.

bane_menu.name: Shaken
bane_menu.effect: You gain one condition that fits what you were doing.

bane_menu.name: Exposed
bane_menu.effect: You are Exposed until the end of your next turn.

bane_rule: A natural 1 always triggers a Bane: -2 to all rolls until the end of your next turn. From Seasoned the GM also picks from the Bane Menu (tier bane_choices), never the same option twice. A Boon Token can cancel it.

level_discount.text: Mana = Power Level - (Character Level / 6, rounded down), minimum 1. Caster and Channeler Roles.

effect_ladder.text: The target gains the type's condition.
As above, and one more target in Close range gains it too.
Every enemy in Close range gains the condition.
Everyone in Near range gains the condition, and the scene changes: the fire spreads, the wall falls, the power grid dies. The GM decides what lasts.

healing_ladder.text: Unmark all Healthy boxes (1–5) in one pool.
Unmark all Healthy and Hurt boxes (1–10) in one pool.
